`final class Shortcut`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.ui.shortcut` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [Shortcut.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/ui/shortcut/Shortcut.java)

A key combination attached to a UI or a node that fires its listeners when the user presses it.

## Description

A shortcut fires only while it is attached, and the Alt, Control and Shift keys must be exactly as set.
By default it waits for the nodes: a focused text field that takes the key keeps it.
The shortcuts of the visible and enabled nodes come first, from the front-most, then those of the UI; the first one that matches consumes the key.

## Creation details

<a id="Shortcut-factory-create"></a>

### create

`Shortcut create(Object binding)` <span class="joid-qualifier">factory</span>

Creates a shortcut on a [`Key`](/reference/input/key/) or on any value that a registered [`KeyResolver`](/reference/input/keyresolver/) turns into a key.
In dev mode, a value that no resolver knows prints a warning; the shortcut fires once a resolver that knows it is registered.
